name: Frostmote · Gremlet #50
description:
A mote of winter light that paints frost on windows when nobody is looking.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Frostmote in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
